sigma_meaning: sigma = one standard uncertainty of the PREDICTION (not of the measurement); score with z = (measured - predicted) / sqrt(sigma^2 + u_measurement^2). Values are honest judgement from tolerance/process.py class values and the SendCutSend +/-0.127 mm figure (taken as ~2 sd), not fitted to any SendCutSend data.

unfold.note: The DXF SendCutSend received was drawn by mechloop (our flat pattern). RP04 is a flat plate with no bends, so it carries no K-factor or bend-allowance test; whoever unfolded it does not matter here, but it is recorded for the bent parts to come (a flange error on a shop-unfolded part tests the shop's consistency, not our K).

what_it_tests: hole diameter vs kerf compensation (5.5 mm x4, 4.0 mm, 1.2 mm)
hole-to-edge web: the 0.8 mm web at H6 (SendCutSend flagged hole-to-edge for order review, as predicted by sendcutsend.specs.min_hole_to_edge 0.965 mm)
slot width: 1.0 mm slot C7 (below mechloop's generic minimum, above SendCutSend's 0.813 mm spec) and the 6 mm legs of the L cut-out C8
sharp inside corner of the L cut-out C8 (kerf radius)
overall size 120 x 80 mm, hole positions, flatness (rock), stock thickness
